items.title: Pat Bryant: On track to play Sunday
items.text:
Coach Sean Payton said Friday that Bryant (ankle) is in line to play in Sunday's game against the Panthers, Chris Tomasson of the Denver Gazette reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Malik Nabers: Ready for Sunday
items.text:
Nabers (knee) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game in Philadelphia.

items.title: Devin Singletary: Ticketed for RB1 duties
items.text:
With Cam Skattebo (hamstring) doubtful to play Week 9, Singletary is expected to operate as the Giants' lead back Sunday against the Eagles, Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.
